enriched_activities.desc: Lie on back in bed. Eyes closed. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Move right arm under pillow. Continue sleeping. Shift legs. Stretch arms. Continue sleeping. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Continue sleeping. Turn to back. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap to face. Rub face. Rinse face with water. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste to toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, and bread. Close refrigerator. Take kettle. Fill kettle with water. Press power button. Open microwave. Place bread inside. Close microwave. Press start. Crack eggs into bowl. Stir eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Transfer eggs to plate. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing bag while checking the storm forecast on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out work shirt. Take out work pants. Lay clothes on bed. Take off sleepwear. Put on work shirt. Put on work pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Open weather app. Read storm forecast. Close weather app. Open bag. Place phone in bag. Place wallet in bag. Place keys in bag. Zip bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Look at watch. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Scroll through news. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Put on gloves. Pick up patient chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Listen to heart. Listen to lungs. Adjust IV drip. Write notes. Walk to next patient. Administer medication. Walk to break room. Drink water. Return to station.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose sandwich. Choose fruit. Choose drink. Pay at cashier. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink beverage. Eat fruit. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away trash. Return tray. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work and patient care at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Enter patient room. Check patient's chart. Administer medication. Adjust patient position. Change bandage. Monitor vital signs. Respond to call button. Assist patient to bathroom. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to nurses' station. Answer phone. Take message. Walk to patient room. Perform blood draw. Label sample. Send sample to lab. Walk to break room. Drink water. Return to station.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker and microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pan. Add meat. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Open microwave. Place bowl inside. Close microwave. Press start. Transfer food to plate. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing for the severe storm: charging devices, closing windows and moving loose items indoors
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up phone. Plug charger into wall outlet. Connect phone to charger. Walk to window. Close window. Lock window. Walk to next window. Close window. Lock window. Pick up loose items from floor. Move items to shelf. Pick up books. Place books on shelf. Pick up clothes. Place clothes in closet. Pick up toys. Place toys in bin. Check doors. Lock doors.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV while the storm passes
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch news. Change channel. Watch movie. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Turn off TV.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water. Adjust temperature. Wet body. Apply soap to body. Rub soap. Rinse body. Apply shampoo to hair. Rub scalp. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter bedroom. Turn on light. Open drawer. Take out pajamas. Close drawer. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Turn to right side. Continue sleeping. Turn to back. Continue sleeping.
